defect: none; an asynchronous level is synchronized before edge detection
rationale: The input crosses through two destination-clocked stages and the edge detector compares only the settled second stage with its delayed copy. The asynchronous reset is excluded from synchronous timing.

mutation.description: Preserved the two-stage level synchronizer and added the ordinary delayed edge detector around its settled output.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced to a self-contained top module with the synchronizer, settled level, and rising/falling outputs.
